column1: Purpose: Track your daily paid ads performance across every campaign.
1. Fill in the Date for each day you have ad data.
2. Fill in CPM, Outbound Click-Through Rate %, Outbound Clicks, and Cost Per Outbound Click.
3. Fill in Results and Cost Per Result.
4. Fill in Application Rate if you run an application funnel, or Schedule Rate if you run a schedule-a-call funnel, you usually only need one.
5. Do this every day you have ad data to log.
